fields.label: Scope
fields.description: Tab = this row hides/reorders an entire tab. Card = this row hides/reorders one card within a tab.

fields.description: For Scope=Tab, this IS the tab being controlled. For Scope=Card, this is the tab the card belongs to.

fields.label: Card Key
fields.description: Must match a cardKey used in employee_hub.js. Leave blank when Scope = Tab.

fields.label: Sequence
fields.description: Relative order within whatever group this item belongs to (tabs among tabs; within a tab, stat cards among stat cards, charts among charts, list cards among list cards).
